rationale: Retain Sabre as one active critical-infrastructure equipment platform and correct the February 2026 transaction from signed pending to closed in the second quarter. TPG Rise Climate is the current majority owner and Blackstone Energy Transition Partners remains a significant-minority owner. Blackstone's SEC-filed second-quarter results list Sabre as a realization, while no public source supports the existing TPG Peppertree Fund X attribution.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Sabre Industries engineers and manufactures transmission and distribution structures, wireless towers and components, integrated enclosures and related products for power utilities, telecommunications operators and data-center developers. The Alvarado, Texas-based platform reported roughly 2,800 employees and more than 2.3 million square feet of U.S. manufacturing space in February 2026. Blackstone acquired Sabre from The Jordan Company in April 2021. TPG announced a majority acquisition through TPG Rise Climate on February 6, 2026, with Blackstone Energy Transition Partners retaining a significant minority; Blackstone's SEC-filed second-quarter 2026 results list Sabre as a realization, establishing that the transaction closed by June 30, although the exact closing date and percentages were not disclosed. Named TPG and Blackstone funds or vehicles are not publicly disclosed, and no later ownership change was identified through August 23, 2026.
